plugin.name: Street Racing Syndicate Fusion Fix
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Choose the language used for plugin settings. Auto follows the game.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen uses the chosen resolution. Windowed shows a window with a picture area of exactly that resolution. Borderless covers the monitor at its desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places the race HUD at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape. Menus keep their 4:3 layout. Applies immediately.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original shows movies as the game does, inside the 4:3 frame. Fill shows the whole movie as large as the screen allows, at its own aspect ratio. Applies immediately.
CutsceneBorders.description: Scripted camera moments, such as the start of street events, are framed for 16:9. Letterbox keeps black bars above and below on narrower screens; Pillarbox keeps the 16:9 picture between side bars on wider screens; Both does both and shows the original framing everywhere; Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: The borders slide in and out as in the original. Off shows and removes them at once. Applies immediately.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the Namco logo and the studio logo movie at startup. The legal screens shown while the game loads stay, and the opening movie still plays (Enter skips it). Takes effect after a restart.
SkipPressStart.description: Continues past the title screen once at startup, without waiting for Enter. Takes effect after a restart.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In Windowed and Borderless modes the game stops while another window is active. Turn off to keep it running in the background. Fullscreen always minimizes and pauses.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the field of view while driving. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values show more. Scripted camera moments keep their framing. Applies immediately.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the game window while the game is active. Releases it when another window is active or when turned off.
ResX.description: Output width in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
ResY.description: Output height in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
CheckForUpdates.description: Checks for a newer fix when enabled. A notice appears at the main menu. FusionFixHub opens the update page after the game exits, when installed beside the game. Disabled by default.
update.availablehub: A new {name} version is available. Update it in FusionFixHub after closing the game.
update.availablesite: A new {name} version is available at fusionfix.io.
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
